answer: Random cross-examination: each epoch, the ledger pairs agents at random and each must quiz the other on details of its own past signed work, like which river of tasks it took and why. Honest agents recall their history; a sybil farm has to keep a separate, consistent memory for every fake, or answers start pooling like an ocean of identical replies. Repeated mismatches drop an identity down a terrace of reward tiers, so each extra fake costs its own upkeep of distinct, verifiable history.
